features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: You cast spells from your spellbook using Intelligence (full caster). You prepare spells from your spellbook; you can copy new spells into it.

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.desc: You can cast any prepared spell as a Ritual if it has the Ritual tag; your spellbook is your ritual reference.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.desc: Once per day, when you finish a Short Rest, you recover spell slots with a combined level of up to half your Wizard level (none higher than level 5).

features.name: Scholar
features.desc: You gain Expertise (double Proficiency Bonus) in one skill: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Medicine, or Religion.

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.desc: When you finish a Short Rest, you can replace one prepared spell with another from your spellbook (without copying).

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.desc: You choose a level 1 and a level 2 spell; you can cast them at will without expending a spell slot (at their base level).

features.name: Signature Spells
features.desc: You choose two level 3 spells; you can cast each once per Short or Long Rest without a spell slot.
